text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh... I can't move...! If the minions 
of evil were to attack right now...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Biko-chan~! Want me to give 
you a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No way! A hero always walks on their own 
two feet...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No matter how... no matter how much...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even if my stomach is heavy!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ A full-course mix of Japanese and 
Western cuisine☆ I was so happy to see you 
clean your plate completely~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's a present from Bono, so...! A hero 
never leaves food behind...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I made a chocolate ice cream 
cake too. It should be set by now, so 
let's go eat~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-There's still more...?! Urgh, ugh... I 
won't... give in...!
